SELECT MIN(s.releaseDate) AS first_date, MAX(s.releaseDate) AS last_date,
       COUNT(*) AS set_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT s.code) AS set_codes,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE manaCost IS NULL) AS null_costs,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE TRIM(manaCost) = '') AS blank_costs,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE manaCost = '{0}') AS printed_zero_costs
FROM sets AS s

arguments.sql:
WITH first_printing AS (
    SELECT s.code, s.name, s.releaseDate
    FROM sets AS s
    WHERE s.releaseDate IS NOT NULL
      AND s.code IN (
          SELECT c.setCode
          FROM cards AS c
          WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
      )
    ORDER BY s.releaseDate ASC, s.code ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
latest_set AS (
    SELECT s.code, s.name, s.releaseDate
    FROM sets AS s
    WHERE s.releaseDate IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY s.releaseDate DESC, s.code ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
selected_sets AS (
    SELECT code, name, releaseDate FROM first_printing
    UNION
    SELECT code, name, releaseDate FROM latest_set
)
SELECT s.name AS set_name,
       ROUND(
           100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN TRIM(c.manaCost) <> ''
                               AND c.convertedManaCost <= 3 THEN 1 END)
           / NULLIF(COUNT(c.id), 0),
           2
       ) AS percentage
FROM selected_sets AS s
LEFT JOIN cards AS c ON c.setCode = s.code
GROUP BY s.code, s.name, s.releaseDate
ORDER BY s.releaseDate ASC, s.code ASC
LIMIT 2
